outcome: Rate of caesarean section on maternal request
cohort: 644 pregnant women who attended a pre-natal education course and 4,134 pregnant women who did not, at the largest tertiary women's hospital in China
finding: Attendance of a pre-natal education course was associated with a higher rate of attempted vaginal delivery and a lower rate of caesarean section on maternal request.
birth_weight: Reported but not included in the findings
